text_block_list.text: "The 'Ramen Training Journey' event held across local racetracks. This time, the stage is... Fukushima!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Well then, to immediately make ramen
that'll delight our Fukushima fans—
choice_data_list: We should start by learning about the local culture.
We should start by learning about the local culture.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Let's give it our all♪
Ready, set, ramen!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text:
"Hip, hip, ramen!"
"Oh, so you're just using that casually now?"

And the place we arrived at was a shop
dealing in Fukushima's traditional crafts—
beautifully colored lacquerware and ceramics.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Waaah~! Beautiful! So this is the famous
ceramics here! It feels so elegant!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
With this, we could go grab a meal or something――
Ah, that's not what this is for, is it?
Ahaha, sorry...

text_block_list.name: Artisan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. No, thank you.
Feedback like that makes me the happiest.

text_block_list.name: Artisan
text_block_list.text: Traditional crafts are often thought of as luxury goods, but at their core...

text_block_list.name: Artisan
text_block_list.text:
Because they support people's everyday lives.
Making someone genuinely want to use it is what brings the greatest joy to both the vessel and the artisan, you know?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I see!
Supporting people's everyday lives...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Fufu♪ Wonderful handicrafts really do carry wonderful feelings within them, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Right! So... what do you think? How about serving ramen in this shop's own bowls?!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that sounds nice too, but... Excuse me,
craftsman? May I ask you something?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "Could we create a work like this with our own hands?"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Ghk... I can't make a straight vessel properly!
Curse you, potter's wheel... Are you in league with curves?!
choice_data_list: Wait, you're trying to make a square prism? With pottery?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hyowaaaa~~~~?!
H-Heeelp meee~~!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait, Doto?! Why are you spinning?!
Ah, your clothes are caught in the potter's wheel--!!?
choice_data_list: I-I'll take it off right now, just hold on!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Top Road, your pottery... it's wonderful!
So simple and large!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Wait, really?!
Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: "...It might be because I listened to the shopkeeper just now—and it really moved me!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Traditional crafts are meant to support people's daily lives. The reason they're loved like this is...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Because they've actually supported them. Because they've lived up to those expectations, right!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Once that thought crossed my mind... yes!
I decided that I wanted to become like that too!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Living up to the expectations placed on me,
and becoming someone they'll keep believing in forever—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I made it sturdy and large,
so it could carry a whole lot of expectations!"
choice_data_list: Fufu, I see. That vessel really suits you.
Fufu, I see. That vessel really suits you.

text_block_list.text:
"Hearing her story made me realize that the vessel she made
is the embodiment of her 'gratitude to her fans.'
That must be why it's so large."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Hey! For this training journey event,
why don't we serve our food in Top Road-san's bowls?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Huh!?
Are you sure you want mine?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Because your vessel overflows
most of all with love for your fans!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
We still have a few days until the event, right?
Let's make lots of bowls before then so we can deliver them to the guests!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
U-Understood! I'll do my best on the finishing touches too!
M-My body is starting to feel hot... hehe.

The bowl was decided. Next, to gather inspiration
for ramen-making, the group visited Fukushima Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! So this is Fukushima Racecourse!
It has gentle undulations, so
looks like it'll require some power too.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Just like Niigata, the stands are so close
to the course, aren't they~? We get to see
the Umamusume run right up close~
choice_data_list: It's precisely because it's the smallest of the Central racecourses.
It's precisely because it's the smallest Central racecourse, you know?

text_block_list.text:
"The compact Fukushima Racecourse puts the fans
and Umamusume close together. Thus, both cheers
and fighting spirit reached each other with ease."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I see! Because it's small, everyone can feel each other's passion! It's a wonderful racecourse!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? A smaller track...?
Maybe that's why you can feel the heat so intensely...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...... If what Fukushima Racecourse has
is its "distinct Fukushima charm," then...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no! —Where should we head next?
Let's learn even more about Fukushima's culture!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Well, speaking of Fukushima culture
involving Umamusume...
it has to be "that", right?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nyah-ha-ha-ha!!
The first banner has been seized by my handsss!!

Next is the Soma Nomaoi.
It's a traditional event held annually in Fukushima, and No Reason and the others were practicing for it today.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"What is it, you all? Do you wish to learn
about the 'Soma Nomaoi'? Heh heh, then allow me to teach you!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: "‘Soma Nomaoi’... 'Tis a festival of Umamusume that has endured for over a millennium!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
What?! A thousand years?!
It's been around for that long?!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. The variety is vast, thou seest…… During the "Grand Procession,"
Umamusume clad in armor parade proudly through the town.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
And there's over 400 of them! The sight of
so many Umamusume gathered together is truly magnificent!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Next up is the "Armor Race"! It's a race where you run around the 1,000m festival grounds wearing battle flags!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Swirling dust, fluttering banners! The audience is glued to their seats
by an excitement distinct from usual races!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Ah, and then, and then!
The conch horn echoes, signaling the start of the battle—!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
The "Sacred Banner Scramble"! The sight of Umamusume
clashing to seize the launched sacred banner is――

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
A true "pitched battle"! Trading blows with polished blades
and matched wits, driving the crowd into a roaring storm of cheers!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
...Well? Passionate, is it not? Profound, is it not!
Hast thou not grown eager to join in as well~?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes...! What an amazing event...!
An event like this has been going on for 1,000 years...?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mm. However, possessing such a long history, its path was full of ups and downs.
I hear there were even times its very existence was threatened.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Yet each time, it changed, seeking the optimal form.
It spared no effort to preserve tradition, continuing to strive forward."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
—And the outcome is what you see now.
Heh, the people of this land are quite admirable.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
How wonderful~! The crafts, the festivals—
Fukushima has done such a lovely job preserving the things everyone holds dear~.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
1000 years... it's continued on...
............

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: ...? What's the ma~tter?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
Um, excuse me!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I want to remake the bowl!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? W-Why is that?
It's such a lovely bowl, imbued with
all of your feelings, Top Road-san.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: True, I poured my feelings into it. But I realized it wasn't the right vessel to convey my gratitude to everyone in Fukushima.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: After all, Fukushima's charm isn't about being big.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Because it means carefully—
'continuing to protect' what must be cherished!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
So, one more time!
Please let me make it again!
And so, a few days later—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
......Phew! Yeah! It's getting better!
Just keep going, bring out even more of Fukushima's spirit—
choice_data_list: Incredible... That's a really nice piece of tableware.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Thank you so much!
What I poured into this vessel
isn't just my feelings alone!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
What the people of Fukushima have passed down.
What they've loved and protected... those feelings as well!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Whoa... So these are Aizu painted candles! They're so detailed, with so many cute flower paintings on them!

text_block_list.name: Candlemaker
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Do you like them?
Winters in Aizu were harsh, so it was always difficult to keep fresh flowers at the altar.

text_block_list.name: Candlemaker
text_block_list.text:
"At times like that, this was offered as a substitute for flowers
—this right here. It's used even at weddings nowadays,
but the underlying meaning hasn't changed."

text_block_list.name: Candlemaker
text_block_list.text:
To add color to the hearts of those who behold it.
That's how this tradition has lived on.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
So I decorated the bowl with a pattern
inspired by Aizu painted candles!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Because I felt that the desire of the people of Fukushima—
"to bring comfort to those who watch"—was right there!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Besides, the akabeko I'm painting right now
is just like that too!

text_block_list.name: Artisan
text_block_list.text:
An Akabeko is a papier-mâché doll meant to ward off pestilence.
Since ancient times, they've been given as gifts to wish for good health.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I see! So it's not just cute, it was made with all those cherished feelings behind it!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
The prayers that the people of Fukushima poured into the Akabeko...
I want to properly reflect that in this vessel!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"I want the people who eat it
to stay healthy too, after all."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
There are other elements too, like designs inspired by the Soma Nomaoi festival!
I packed in tons of Fukushima traditions!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Along with the feelings woven into that culture.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
So please watch me.
At the event, without fail!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'll present a vessel that lives up
to the expectations of everyone in Fukushima!

And so, the day of the
ramen event in Fukushima arrived—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
All done! A scallion ramen inspired by scallion soba broth!
Now, all that's left is to serve it in that bowl and—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Thanks for waiting!

text_block_list.name: Customers
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, traditional pottery!" "It's so intricate!"
"There's a painting of an Akabeko!" "So pretty..."
"Is this from the Soma Nomaoi?" "Awesome!!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I expressed the feelings of the people of Fukushima in my own way.
If it resonates with you, I'd be thrilled!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"...Coming here to Fukushima
has taught me something."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I didn't have much confidence in myself.
I kept wondering if just working hard and staying earnest was really enough.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Still, you sincerely protect tradition, carry it on, and pass it forward.
Fukushima, which has its "present" because of that, taught me this.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: By doing small things steadily, one by one—and seeing them through to the very end, the summit is within reach!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
So, even if I don't stand out like my classmates!
I'll keep running for a long time, just like Fukushima!

text_block_list.name: Customers
text_block_list.text:
"‘...Hang in there! You got this!’ ‘We're rooting for you!’
‘Thanks for the delicious ramen!’ ‘Your feelings reached us!’
‘Come make ramen for us again!’"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I wonder if I managed to give back even a little of what I've received.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Alright. I'll present these vessels at the year-end event too,
and delight the fans just like in Fukushima. I'm so thrilled.
Because the "Ramen Jamboree" is on a completely different scale, we'll likely need dozens of times more bowls than this.

Also, applying such an elaborate design to every single bowl
would be difficult. Making it a one-time thing was the realistic choice.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I see, what a pity. And here I was hoping to smugly brag, "Look at this fine vessel! We're geniuses, gahaha!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, ha... True, it's a shame
we can't use this vessel. But—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
No matter what happens, keep moving forward without slackening, step by step.
I learned that spirit from everyone in Fukushima.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I'm thinking of bringing that to the year-end event. Instead of a bowl!
